description.value: Lakeside resort campground on the shore of Osoyoos Lake—Canada's warmest—at the edge of the Sonora Desert, with beach access, indoor pool, marina, and Indigenous cultural attractions next door; easy paved access from town, though the resort scale and pricing lean heavily toward RV visitors.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at campingosoyoos.com is fully accessible and provides rich primary evidence. The site confirms open year-round operation, tent-friendly sites, an on-site cantina (Spirit Beach Cantina), clean water, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a detailed online booking system — confirming reservations accepted. The contact page provides the address (8000 – 45th Street, Osoyoos, BC) and phone (250-495-7279), neither of which appeared in the OSM record; these are used as the canonical values since OSM had no conflicting data. No specific hiker/biker designation, showers, laundry, tools, pump, or cycling-specific amenities are mentioned on the website.
concerns: OSM record had no phone or address; both were sourced exclusively from the website and could not be cross-checked against OSM data.
OSM name capitalizes as 'Nk'Mip' while the website uses 'NK'Mip' / 'NK'MIP' interchangeably — minor discrepancy retained per rule 6.
Park is primarily an RV resort; tent/hiker-biker accommodation is available but not prominently featured or separately designated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, operating campground open year-round with confirmed tent sites, clean water, on-site food, and online reservations — a strong fit for touring cyclists passing through the South Okanagan.
enrichment_extras.notes: On-site convenience store noted; may sell ice or camping supplies but no explicit evidence — marked null per evidence rules.

wow_evidence: lakeside resort campground on the shore of Osoyoos Lake—Canada's warmest—at the edge of the Sonora Desert, with beach access
